orders.changes: Rebuilt the R02 face in head-0275 with a new script, rebuild_face_features_field.py (committed e936d43e). The old eye pocket is filled with a fitted face surface and a shallow socket is cut. New eyes are a shallow dome, flush at the bottom rim and standing proud at the apex, with a tapered dark lid band (heavy upper outer, thin lower inner) and a thin iris lens. The aperture is .0837 to .2697 by -.1142 to .1388 head-local, matching the spec. Every eye part sits at or behind world y -.1697 (worst -.1684). Rim to dome depth is .005 to .0088 local on both eyes. The bridge and nose are pushed forward to the sheet's profile table; the nose tip is at local y -.3814 against a -.3812 target. The nose shell is replaced by a dark decal buried at its rim. The chin knob was only softened by a blur, so R02.4 is judged on the muzzle and upper lip. Three leaf tufts per side were added, and the lower face and chin were blurred. Assembled with the baseline body body-0263 as assembled-0276; technical check passes (1 component, 0 non-manifold edges). Head IoU in the quick fit rose from .8293 to .8311. Side head IoU (R01.2) rose from .9175 to .9264. No criterion flipped result. R01.6 moved from 1.009 to 1.065 (still a pass) because the tufts add width. R06 and R10 fails are unchanged (body untouched). I did not grade the visual criteria; the critic should judge them from m05. Not done exactly to spec: the lid overhang is approximated by a cutter shear, the iris lens is thicker than the spec's .001 world, and the lid band is a dark material zone rather than a separate strip. The philtrum line (closed_mouth_2) is trimmed above z -.178.
